components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 20px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: #0660f5; color: #fff; font: 600 13px/1.4 Manrope, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 5px 16px #0055e51c; cursor: pointer; transition: color .18s, background-color .18s, box-shadow .18s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2878ff; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px #0055e52b; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5291ff; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet alternative action with a precise hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 1px solid #253147; border-radius: 7px; background: #101c30; color: #f2f5fc; font: 600 13px/1.4 Manrope, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color .18s, background-color .18s, border-color .18s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #5291ff; color: #5291ff; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5291ff; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Compact catalogue filter in a quiet outlined style.
components.css: .ds-chip { padding: 8px 13px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #9eaac0; font: 400 12px/1.75 Manrope, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color .18s, background-color .18s, border-color .18s; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #0c1425; color: #f2f5fc; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: #253147; background: #142648; color: #5291ff; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5291ff; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: Quiet content surface separated by tonal layering and a hairline.
components.html:
Technical discipline

Systems built with clarity and care.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 25px; border: 1px solid #253147; border-radius: 12px; background: #101c30; color: #f2f5fc; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 17px 0 12px; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.18; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-card p { margin: 0 0 1.2em; color: #9eaac0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.75; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Theme-surface field with a clear accent focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #9eaac0; font: 600 11px/1.5 Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid #253147; border-radius: 6px; background: #0c1425; color: #f2f5fc; font: 400 14px/1.5 Manrope, sans-serif; transition: border-color .18s, box-shadow .18s; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: #5291ff; outline: 2px solid #5291ff; outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #7586a2; }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Compact route navigation with a restrained accent hover.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; font: 600 11px/1.5 Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color: #9eaac0; text-decoration: none; transition: color .18s; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { color: #5291ff; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5291ff; outline-offset: 5px; }

narrative.overview:
CPSI LABS presents an independent software lab through the confidence of a considered technical publisher. The actual interlocking CS mark is the identity's hero artifact; orbital linework echoes its connected geometry. Wide, direct typography and precise hairlines give the work presence while quiet surfaces keep the content in focus.

The system supports an honest catalogue, technical documentation, company information, support, and legal content across English and French. Dark navy is the primary environment; a pale blue-white light theme carries the same hierarchy and electric-blue identity. Components stay familiar and restrained, while page sections vary their composition to suit their content. English is the default language, and both themes are first-class.
keyCharacteristics: Premium independent technology publisher, centered on the real CS symbol.
Deep navy, electric blue, cool whites, and disciplined hairlines.
Broad Manrope typography, calm surfaces, and varied section compositions.
Responsive bilingual experience with dark and light themes.
Motion is finite and purposeful; reduced-motion preferences are honored.

rules.name: The Theme-Paired Accent Rule
rules.body: Use the dark or light accent/action values with their corresponding theme; do not carry dark-theme blue onto light surfaces when the light token is defined.

dos: Do use the supplied, real CS symbol as the identity mark and preserve its proportions.
Do pair theme-specific colors and maintain readable contrast in both themes.
Do use Manrope and the observed display, headline, title, body, and label hierarchy.
Do vary page section compositions while preserving the shared palette, typography, hairlines, and controlled radii.
Do keep primary actions clear and use `#0660f5` dark / `#065ee9` light with their defined hover colors.
donts: Don't invent product dashboards, apps, customer logos, metrics, or testimonials for an empty catalogue.
Don't substitute a fabricated monogram or unrelated symbol for the supplied CS mark.
Don't use the dark accent as the light-theme accent; use `#0058dd` in light mode.
Don't add decorative motion that competes with the content or persists under reduced-motion preferences.
Don't introduce unrelated accent colors, heavy gradients, or oversized shadows into the quiet technical palette.
